exit.name: Assembly (Intel / NASM / MASM) Linux exit example
exit.body:
; NASM, x86-64 Linux
bits 64
section .text
global _start
_start:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

boot-sector.name: x86 BIOS boot sector (NASM flat binary)
boot-sector.body:
; Build: nasm -f bin boot.asm -o boot.bin
; Legacy x86 BIOS only; not UEFI. Does not load a kernel.
bits 16
org 0x7c00

jmp 0x0000:start
start:
    cli
    xor ax, ax
    mov ds, ax
    mov es, ax
    mov ss, ax
    mov sp, 0x7c00
    cld
    sti
    mov ax, 0x0e54 ; BIOS teletype: T
    xor bx, bx
    int 0x10
.halt:
    cli
    hlt
    jmp .halt

times 510 - ($ - $$) db 0
dw 0xaa55
